name: Woodgrain
author: E. T. Carter
description: A quartersawn oak board filling the frame. Tight parallel growth rings open into cathedral arches where the cut grazes a ring, each ring a pale porous earlywood darkening into a hard winter line; slanted ray flecks lie glassy across the grain and flash one after another as a lamp circles above the board, while the plank creeps slowly along its length.

params.label: Ring density
params.effect: Growth rings per unit; low is a few broad slow-grown bands, high is tight dense grain.

params.label: Cathedral
params.effect: How far the pith wanders under the board; 0 is dead-straight quartersawn lines, high opens wide cathedral arches.

params.label: Ray fleck
params.effect: Density and brightness of the medullary ray flecks; 0 removes them.

params.label: Finish
params.effect: Gloss of the finish: strength of the grain sheen and the fleck flashes; 0 is raw sanded timber.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the circling lamp and the creep along the plank; 0 holds the board still.
